correctness.rationale: For K_n whose simplices are edge subsets extendible to perfect matchings of C_n square K2, a point fixed by a simplicial automorphism has invariant support with equal barycentric coordinates on its edge orbits. For primitive rotation r^k, the horizontal rim orbits contain adjacent edges, hence cannot be simplices; full rung orbit is the unique invariant matching facet, so exactly its barycenter is fixed. For sr^k, horizontal edges lie in a single nonmatching orbit for odd n, whereas for even n they split into two alternate perfect-matching orbits, disjoint from the rung facet as combinatorial faces; exactly three isolated fixed barycenters. Lefschetz fixed point count gives reduced trace 0 (rotation/odd screw) or 2 (even screw). Independently checked orbit and matching predicates for all primitive k and widths n=3..9, without replacing the all-n gcd/parity orbit proof.
